checkpoints.title: init --identity works from a remote shell or a phone: an HTTPS start page, a github.com redirect page, a pasted address checked against the state, install only after a successful conversion, and a timeout that exits 4
contracts: Env.manifestCode: loopback flow only where the browser is on this machine; otherwise the paste flow
initrepo.AppManifest: redirect_url is the given page
initrepo.ErrAppNotConverted: a failed conversion writes no secret and prints no Install link
the site writes app-manifest.html, which posts the manifest from its fragment to github.com only
instrumentation: the init report names the identity step's result: created, not converted (delete the App), or waiting for the person
checkpoints.rollback: revert the PR; init --identity falls back to the loopback flow
